proposals.title: CanonicalEncoder fourth attempt: fix two TASK-0006-review-03 MAJOR findings
proposals.why_now: TASK-0006 was rejected three times. Review-03 narrowed the open issues to exactly two: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and Number.NaN are read at call time in capturedParseInt10, allowing a post-import accessor monkeypatch to execute user code during array traversal; and npm run compile plus npm run boundary output is absent from the validation record. Both are precisely specified and fixable without redesign. All StateHash, replay CLI, INV-01, and INV-22 work remains blocked until the encoder is accepted. Twenty-five consecutive heartbeat checkpoints with zero accepted commits make this the single most urgent deliverable.

proposals.title: Branded numeric types and division helper (ADR-003 + ADR-004)
proposals.why_now: The branded numeric types — Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint nominal types; Tick and safe-integer coordinates as number nominal types — are the primitive vocabulary that every subsequent FASE-1 deliverable depends on: ledger entries, price queries, RNG coordinates, and the tick loop. None of those can be implemented without these types in packages/core. ADR-004 requires every division to declare a rounding mode; establishing the helper and the enforcement mechanism now prevents retrofitting across all future arithmetic code. This work is fully independent of the CanonicalEncoder and can proceed in parallel.

Twenty-five consecutive heartbeat checkpoints with zero accepted commits represent significant schedule risk. The benchmark is 30 days; no functional FASE-1 deliverable has been merged. Parallel progress on independent tracks (IDEA-002, IDEA-003, IDEA-004) is critical to recover time.
